claims.text: Frór's older brother Thrór then became King of Durin's Folk and led part of his house back to Lonely Mountain. The rest of those who left traveled East to the Iron Hills with the youngest brother Grór, who founded his own realm.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix A, "Durin's Folk"
